newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-DEPORTIVO AND BETIS KEEP UP THE PRESSURE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DEPORTIVO AND BETIS KEEP UP THE PRESSURE.

text.p: Deportivo Coruna went home from Sevilla with a 1-0 win on Sunday to take second place behind Real Madrid in the Spanish first division.
With 33 points from 15 games, Deportivo are two off the pace after Real Madrid's 1-0 victory at Sporting Gijon on Saturday, and two ahead of Barcelona, who play Extremadura on Monday.

Two points back on 29 are Real Betis, 2-0 winners at Compostela, and a further two points behind them are reigning champions Atletico Madrid, who took fifth after beating Racing Santander 1-0 on Saturday.
Zaragoza dedicated their first home win of the season -- 1-0 over Oviedo -- to late club president Alfonso Solans, who died on Friday morning.
